description: Changes to a vector's input for live replay (bench verify), each with its reason. Applied to the expected request as well, so the request check stays exact. Read by bench/src/verify/verify.ts; the offline suites never read this file.

scraping results makes an unreported cos.reason: scrapeOptions scrapes every result at an unpublished cost; one result bounds a live replay at 2 search credits plus 1 scrape credit (and 1 per PDF page). The vector checks only the scrapeOptions it sends, not the result count.

scrape maps one URL; a title array is jo.reason: The vector's https://example.com/page is a 404 live (checked 2026-11-25); https://example.com/ serves 200, which the vector scripts.
